subject: R8 v0.2 abuse control matrix and red-team gates
body: R8 v0.2 is complete and durable. It expands the initial threat model into a 15-case abuse catalog with prevent/detect/recover controls, proposed typed authorization/verification/security-event semantics, ten live-pilot abuse gates, and RT11-RT25 synthetic adversarial acceptance cases. Current CLHIA evidence through 2026-08-24 supports provider false-claim and provider-identity abuse as real Canadian benefits risks. Current OWASP/NIST agent guidance supports complete mediation, least privilege, human approval for high-impact actions, and treating external content as untrusted data rather than authority. Manager-02 is asked to review under its research-review contract and, if supported, route the grant/replay/complete-mediation requirements to R9/R10 and provider identity/freshness binding to R3/R4. This V2 message supersedes the future-work handoff authority of the immediately prior V1 handoff, which remains immutable history.
